items.title: 32.2 Medah mein pH ki ahmiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.2, printed page 231 (PDF 234). The stomach diagram is our aid, not a printed figure.

blocks.text: Maida (stomach) bohat tezabi (acidic) jagah hai; is ka pH kam, yani 1.5 se 3.5 tak hota hai. Yeh tezabiyat parietal cells control karte hain, jo zor laga kar hydrogen ions (H⁺) maide mein pump karte hain. Yeh amal khana hazam karne aur bacteria ko maarne ke liye zaroori hai. pH itna kam hone ke bawajood maida apni hifazat khud karta hai: is ki deewar par mucus (chipchipa maaya) ki moti teh aur bicarbonate ions hote hain, jo cell ki satah par acid ko neutralize (be-asar) kar dete hain.

Maide ka kam pH non-specific reactions (aise reactions jo kisi khaas maqsad ke baghair ho jaate hain) kar sakta hai, yani yeh kuch dawaiyon ko chemically badal sakta hai. Maslan kuch dawaiyan khoon mein absorb (jazb) hone se pehle hi tezabi mahol mein toot jaati hain. Isi liye kuch dawaiyan aik hifazati coating (teh) ke saath di jaati hain jo sirf kam tezabi small intestine (chhoti aant) mein jaa kar ghulti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: medah ka andar (pH 1.5-3.5, H+ ions), us ke neeche mucus + HCO3- ki tah ('neutralise acid'), aur sab se neeche deewar ke cells jin se do surkh teer H+ ko andar pump karte hain ('parietal cells pump H+'). Daen: coated goli medah mein saboot ('coating intact'), phir small intestine mein coating ghul jati hai ('coating dissolves').
blocks.caption: Medah ki tezabiyat aur coated goliyan (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Maida apni deewar ko apne hi acid se kaise bachata hai?
blocks.explanation: Mucus ki moti teh aur bicarbonate ions se, jo cell ki satah par acid ko neutralize kar dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Kuch goliyon par khaas coating kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Taake dawa maide ke tez acid mein toot na jaye; coating sirf kam tezabi chhoti aant mein ghulti hai jahan dawa jazb hoti hai.

items: Maide ka pH 1.5–3.5; parietal cells H⁺ ions pump karte hain.
Mucus aur bicarbonate ions maide ki deewar bachate hain.
Acid kuch dawaiyan tor deta hai; is liye coated goliyan chhoti aant mein ghulti hain.
